handoff.summary: Cycle 6 completed T-009+T-010: phase3-interventions done. Domain: src/domain/intervention.ts (partition/stop/double-propose/double-vote/delay/drop as pure data; compileDelivery + directivesForSlot compile them onto the engine's existing delivery/directives axes) and src/domain/scenario.ts (Scenario = config+interventions; scenarioStates = anchor recomputation, shared rewind/determinism path). Compatible engine extensions only: Delivery gained a 5th MessageRef arg (4-arg fns still conform), advanceSlot gained optional SlotDirectives, stopped proposer leaves an empty slot. UI: InterventionPanel.tsx (all four intervention families specified at the next slot boundary; scheduled list with 解消/復帰/削除 that deterministically rewrites history), useSimulation reworked to (config, interventions, runSlot, cursor) with states from scenarioStates, slot-bar cursor ◀/▶/最新へ with truncate-on-advance-from-past, and the compiled delivery now feeds ChainMode/NetworkMode local views (CRITICAL pattern: observe() defaults to instantDelivery — always pass session.delivery). Evidence green: typecheck 0, vitest 11 files / 94 tests 0, build 0. changed_files 24 is at the reset threshold's edge — this handoff assumes a fresh session reading only the disk.
next_actions: T-011 (phase4-scenario, cost 4): scenario save/load/replay. Scenario type already exists in src/domain/scenario.ts (config + interventions = complete run identity; determinism test in tests/domain/intervention.test.ts proves same scenario -> same states). Add (de)serialization in domain (JSON schema with version field; validate on load — Intervention is a tagged union, reject unknown kinds), then UI: save current scenario (download JSON and/or localStorage list), load + replay (set scenario, recompute via scenarioStates, cursor to 0 or saved runSlot). Persist runSlot too so a replay reproduces the exact displayed run. Keep domain free of DOM/storage APIs — file/localStorage I/O belongs to src/ui.

Then phase5-polish: T-012 (no-manual operability pass over ALL scenario operations; success criteria 5/7/8 end-to-end: partition divergence観測, heal convergence, equivocation visibility, rewind, save/reload identical results) and T-013 (verification gate + GitHub Pages path check; vite base './' already set).
UI must keep consuming ONLY src/domain exports (tests/domain/purity.test.ts enforces).

Essence gates: (a) semantics changes of View/Vote/protocol skeleton and (b) large UI look/info-design pivots go back to the human. Intervention semantics decisions are recorded in reflection.jsonl cycle 6 (decision entry): monotone partition delivery, stop=silenced-not-blinded, same-parent double propose, parent-head double vote, sender-exempt delay/drop, truncate-on-advance, editable interventions rewrite history.

Older discretionary semantics: SLOTS_PER_EPOCH=4; same-slot equivocation resolved lexicographically; anchor slot 0 / first proposal slot 1; attestations of a slot simultaneous (votes visible through s-1).

R-001 (proposed, non-blocking): human may enable real-browser verification via 'npx playwright install chromium' once; until then jsdom DOM tests are the autonomous verification layer. npm install needs --cache "$TMPDIR/npm-cache" under the sandbox.
